page.overview:
Who is Multo?

Multo is a character in the G.I. Joe Real American Hero comics from IDW and Skybound.

Multo is the first Filipino to join the G.I. Joe team and specializes in jungle warfare. Multo was created by Larry Hama.

JUNGLE WARFARE (Special Ops) Codename: MULTO

MULTO ("ghost" in Tagalog) came up through the slums along the Pasig River in the Tondo district of Manila. Determined to have a better life, he joined the army and by dint of hard work and exceptional skills, qualified for Special Forces, where he eventually became a jungle warfare instructor. After his discharge from the Philippine Army, he emigrated to the U.S. and promptly enlisted in the U.S. Army. He is Ranger qualified, and has expert qualifications with the M4A1 5.56mm carbine, M21 7.62mm sniper rifle, M11 9mm pistol, and M249 5.56 SAW. He is fluent in Spanish, Tagalog, and French.
